title: wsutil: Remove calls to "application flavor" API
description:
Refactor code to push up where the application flavor API is called so it is not called from within wsutil.  Most of this is derived from "file system APIs" that can get information from the environment variables on a given platform.

Other libraries should get similar treatment so that application flavor API can be its own library linked to applications only.

wsutil: Remove calls to "application flavor" API

Refactor code to push up where the application flavor API is called so it is not called from within wsutil.  Most of this is derived from "file system APIs" that can get information from the environment variables on a given platform.

Other libraries should get similar treatment so that application flavor API can be its own library linked to applications only.
